clip_research.source_claim: Market pricing implies roughly a coin-flip chance CoreWeave goes bankrupt in the next few years, though it is not actually paying 15% on all its balance-sheet debt and its customers are highly profitable investment-grade firms.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public reporting shows CoreWeave CDS spreads at record/distress levels, bonds near 77-80 cents with yields above 15%, and S&P B+/Moody's Ba3 junk ratings — consistent with elevated but not certain default risk.
clip_research.surprise_gap: Speaker pushes back on the most alarmist headlines: default odds are elevated but the company is not paying 15% on all debt, and its customers are investment-grade, so the market signal overstates near-term distress.

evidence.fact: Speaker says there is a 'coin flip chance' CoreWeave goes bankrupt in the next few years, citing CDS spreads.
Speaker says CoreWeave is not paying 15% on the debt on its balance sheet, but unsecured financing costs are rising.
Speaker says CoreWeave's customers include Microsoft, Meta and Google, described as profitable investment-grade firms.
CNBC reports CoreWeave CDS hit distress levels as investors soured on AI debt.
CDS spread topped 1,000 bps, pricing roughly 60% five-year default odds, with bond yields near 15%.

大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
